Name: SDVPP
Author: lucaspospor
Description:
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/red-socket/sdvpp/main/media/banner.png[/img][/center]

SDV++ adds quality-of-life changes to Stardew Valley 1.6. It works in single-player and in co-op, including split-screen, and you can turn off every feature.

[size=5][b]Farming and shops[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]On the last day of spring, summer and fall, Pierre and JojaMart also sell next season's seeds.[/*]
[*]Craft a Quality Sprinkler from a Sprinkler, and an Iridium Sprinkler from a Quality Sprinkler.[/*]
[*]Robin can upgrade a Silo to a Big Silo (500 hay), then to a Deluxe Silo (750 hay).[/*]
[*]A sprinkler that reaches the pet bowl fills it every morning.[/*]
[*]Refill your watering can at the Pelican Town fountain, except in winter.[/*]
[*]Hold, place or point at a sprinkler, scarecrow, bee house or Junimo hut to see the tiles it covers.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Villagers[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Mayor Lewis sends a letter the day before your wedding, so you can dress for it.[/*]
[*]Lewis also asks for your birthday. On the day, villagers wish you a happy birthday, your spouse congratulates you, close friends send small gifts, and the date shows on the calendar.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Storage[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The log pile next to the farmhouse stores Wood and Hardwood, shared by the whole farm.[/*]
[*]Crafting at home and Robin's buildings and house upgrades can use the wood in it.[/*]
[*]Unused fishing tackle stacks.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Fewer accidents[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The game asks before a warp totem or the Return Scepter sends you away.[/*]
[*]Clicking a crop or forage with food in hand doesn't ask whether to eat it.[/*]
[*]Opening a door with an item in hand doesn't give it to a villager standing below the door.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Decorating[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Time stops at home while you hold furniture.[/*]
[*]Robin can paint silos: the walls, the dome and the ring under it.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Travel[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]New minecart stops in Cindersap Forest, near the farm, and on the Beach. They open with the rest of the minecart network.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Interface[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The title screen skips the intro and gets to the menus faster.[/*]
[*]The title, load, co-op and character creation screens use your UI scale.[/*]
[*]The options menu offers a larger UI scale (up to what fits your screen) and zoom up to 250%.[/*]
[*]Use menus with the keyboard: arrow keys, Enter or Space, Backspace, number keys for answers, Escape on the title screen.[/*]
[*]Fades between locations are twice as fast.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip SDV++ into your Mods folder. Keep both folders inside, SDVPP and SDVPP.Content.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]In co-op, every player needs the same version of SDV++.

[size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Settings are in Mods/SDVPP/config.json and Mods/SDVPP.Content/config.json. With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can change them in game.

[size=5][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Each sprinkler upgrade recipe counts toward Craft Master and Perfection, so craft each one once.[/*]
[*]Big and Deluxe Silos look like a regular silo.[/*]
[*]If you remove SDV++, upgraded silos lose their building data, and stacks of tackle shrink to one item when the game next moves them.[/*]
[*]The zoom buttons next to the clock still stop at 200%. Use the options menu for higher zoom.[/*]
[/list]The full list of settings and limitations is in the [url=https://github.com/red-socket/sdvpp]README on GitHub[/url].
